Class VirtualServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.client.VirtualServer
public class VirtualServer extends Object
Handles the client-side network connection to a remote server.

This singleton class manages socket communication, background threads for message listening and connection health monitoring (via ping), and delegates received messages to the UI layer via a callback interface.

    • attemptConnection

      public void attemptConnection(String hostName, int portNumber) throws IOException
      Attempts to establish a socket connection to the specified server. Starts a daemon thread to listen for incoming messages.
      Parameters:
      hostName - the server hostname or IP address
      portNumber - the port to connect to
      Throws:
      IOException - if the connection fails

    • listenForMessages

      public void listenForMessages()
      Starts listening for messages from the server in a blocking loop. Automatically handles disconnections, pings, and UI message dispatch.

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the socket connection and associated input/output streams. Marks the client as disconnecting to prevent watchdog from reopening alerts.

    • sendMessage

      public void sendMessage(GameMessage message)
      Sends a message to the server by serializing it into JSON.
      Parameters:
      message - the message to send
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if serialization fails

    • handleMessageFromServer

      public void handleMessageFromServer(String msg)
      Handles an incoming JSON-formatted message from the server. Automatically updates ping timestamp or delegates to the UI.
      Parameters:
      msg - the message received from the server

    • setCallBack

      public void setCallBack(UICallBack newCallBack)
      Sets the callback used to deliver messages to the UI. All queued messages are flushed to the new callback if provided.
      Parameters:
      newCallBack - the callback implementation to use
